description.en:
📡 WORKSHOP: ESPecially Connected! ⚡

Join us to explore ESP32 microcontrollers, learn how to connect them, and discover their functionality through hands-on experience with embedded electronics!

Whether you’re new to microcontrollers or looking to expand your hardware and electronics skills, this workshop is for you!

📅 Friday, November 27
⏰ 6 to 8 PM
📍 STM 364

🔗 Sign up through the link in our bio!

See you there! 💙
